title: Filtered deformations of Lie groupoids
summary: Let $G \rightrightarrows G^{(0)}$ be a Lie groupoid, $\mathrm{A} G \rightarrow G^{(0)}$ its Lie algebroid and $X_1, \dots, X_r$ a family of sections of $\mathrm{A} G$ satisfying a Lie bracket generating condition of Hörmander type. We aim to build a pseudodifferential calculus allowing to study a Helffer-Nourrigat's conjecture on the groupoid $G$; in particular, we want differential operators of the form $\sum_{i = 1}^r X_i^2$ to have an invertible symbol.
